sample_unit: people living with HIV (4,809,765 EMR records)

links.outcome: Fine-tuned LLM performance versus supervised ML and zero-shot LLMs on same data
links.effect: Enhanced LLMs outperformed the supervised ML model and zero-shot LLMs across all outcomes in both internal and external validation datasets.
links.quote: The enhanced LLMs consistently outperformed the supervised ML model and zero-shot LLMs across all outcomes in both internal and external validation datasets.

unlisted_practices: fine-tuning an open-source LLM on routine EMR data for retention-in-care risk prediction
physician assessment of LLM-generated justifications for predictions

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates an LLM fine-tuned for predicting HIV care disengagement and includes an offline clinical expert review to evaluate output reasoning and justifications.
